comment: Track P P.4 phase 1 on Ada (SSH alias experiment_zhixu; 8 x NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada Generation 48 GB, sm_89), started directly over SSH under a GPU lease (p4_direct.py; R1-HOST-FREE), image v2.2 (R1-TRACKP-IMAGE-V22-B, 24 Nov 2026: gpu sha256:49dd9900…, cpu sha256:a3b3a074…, tag 20261124-v2.2-667bb9c2; docs/r1/reports/trackp_v22_20261123/V22_BUILD_20261124.md; causal_conv1d built for TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST 8.0;8.9;9.0). The same bases, revisions, LoRA, lr grid, pins and SFT settings as trackp_htcondor_v2.json; only the GPU record, the lease and the direct-launch host values differ. The compute agent fills every TODO_VERIFY_ON_HOST value from its survey of Ada with r1/scripts/htcondor/trackp_p4/p4_fill_host_config.py --host-class ada_rtx6000 (paths inside the job, the GPU record, the container runtime, the work root, the lease directory, the hostname); --check-config lists them and real runs refuse a config that still holds one. AI-assisted (Claude); ENGINEERING_ONLY config.

gpu.name: NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada Generation
gpu.comment: R1-HOST-FREE: the GPU model is recorded per job, not fixed; this class's jobs run on one RTX 6000 Ada card each, leased by p4_direct.py and visible to the job by UUID

lr_grid_comment: R1-LR-GRID (author, 26 Oct): one adapter-lr grid for every family, chosen by val RPS; replaces the per-base lr of spec §4 for P.3a onwards (the per-base 'lr' values are the P.0/P.4 engineering runs' lr and stay for spike/toy only). New heads keep head_lr 1e-3.
token_lr_comment: R1-TOKEN-INIT (author, 26 Oct: 'train those rows in fp32 at a lower lr'): the bin-token family's new token rows, fp32, lr 1e-4 (10x below new heads; value chosen by the Track P agent, author to confirm).

venv.causal_conv1d: 1.7.0 built from the pinned sdist for sm_89, wheel sha256 8f676dbd2d42588d4fa85aabcb2da8f1bd9bf46dbdeea7b51c7dddf01e4e3e6f, R1-TRACKP-IMAGE-V22-B; imports on the Ada venv
venv.torch_pin: torch==2.6.0+cu124 (R1-ENV-PIN, author 26 Oct: kept on driver 535 via CUDA minor-version compatibility)
venv.comment: image v2 env3 = the committed trackp-gpu freeze (R1-HTC-QTORCH / R1-QTORCH-AMEND); check_environment verifies torch and the code pins at run time

code_pins_comment: R1-ENV-PIN: Kev code pinned at the exact commit used in P.0 (2074cc4), 23 commits after the kev-1.0 tag; its diff to the tag is recorded in docs/r1/reports/trackp_phase2_20261026/kev_diff_vs_kev-1.0.*

sft.comment: P4-MB A (R1-TRACKP-P4-DECISIONS, 21 Nov 2026): micro-batch 8, effective batch 16 in two accumulation steps, as the SFT default; the class's own SFT fit and timing probe confirms the fit on a 48 GB card with gradient checkpointing off; an OOM is a STOP

spike.comment: 13 steps x batch 8 = one pass over the 100 toy examples (P.0 '100-example toy SFT'; was 10 = 80 examples, STOP 3 review)

e0.comment: R1-E0-PROTOCOL + R1-E0-BUDGET (author, 26 Oct): lr screen on lr_grid (<= 2,000 steps, chosen by val RPS), then one run at the selected lr (cap 6,000, eval every 100, patience 10); E0 metrics from that run; the hard-label and native runs reuse the selected lr with the final budget. Screen patience 5 is the Track P agent's (eval every 100 confirmed, R1-TRACKP-CHOICES). Head fit: full-batch L-BFGS on CPU, descriptive (R1-E0-HEADFIT).

kev_temperature.post_hoc: temperature scaling on dev, the same procedure for every model (R1-TEMPERATURE)

jev.comment: R1-JEV-RUNG / R1-EDGES-10 (author, 26 Oct): jev-1.14.0; 10 yes/no questions (one per finite bin edge). Verify with the key that the name exists before Phase 7; the client refuses a different returned version.

lease_comment: The card is leased outside the job by p4_direct.py (an exclusive flock on <direct.lock_dir>/gpu<N>.lock, the same lock the host's other jobs take) and only that card is visible in the container: trackp.py passes an empty Track X schedule to its in-job GPU lease (no origin/main STATUS.md is read inside the job) and skips its foreign-compute-process check, because the card may be shared by design (R1-CARD-SHARE (1): the launcher checked its free memory and records the other processes at start and end); the in-job flock at gpu.lock_path applies.

direct.comment: The fill selects apptainer, docker, or venv. The reviewed Ada venv uses Python 3.12.10 and the env3 package lock. Image v2.2 uses Python 3.12.15. See docs/r1/reports/trackp_p4_20261127/ADA_P4_VENV_20261127.md. The launcher leases one GPU and checks available memory. The shm_size field applies to docker.
